chief_complaint: Worsening depressive symptoms in bipolar II disorder
subjective: 47-year-old male with bipolar II disorder on lamotrigine 200 mg daily reports two weeks of worsening depression: low mood most of the day, anhedonia, decreased appetite, hypersomnia 12 hours/night. No hypomanic features. Denies active SI but endorses passive death wishes. No medication side effects.

assessment.description: Bipolar II disorder, current depressive episode

plan: Increase lamotrigine to 250 mg PO daily, reassess in 2 weeks. Add bupropion XL 150 mg PO daily, titrate to 300 mg if tolerated. Discussed activation symptoms and switch risk. Safety plan reviewed and documented. Return in 2 weeks.
flags_for_review: Passive death wishes endorsed — confirm safety plan documented and assess change in risk over the next visit.
Bupropion XL titration plan to 300 mg pending tolerability — confirm follow-up dose adjustment.
